maturity_scope: Documentation and workflow foundation; no certification, authorization, endorsement, or operational maturity claim

01-ai-agent-security.purpose: Review tool-using AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations.
01-ai-agent-security.when_to_use: Use when an AI system can access tools, APIs, files, code, email, cloud, data, or operational workflows.
01-ai-agent-security.primary_decision: Green / Amber / Red / More evidence required

02-evidence-manifests.purpose: Create a traceable evidence package for a system or review.
02-evidence-manifests.when_to_use: Use at the start of any system, asset, readiness, audit, or public-release review.
02-evidence-manifests.primary_decision: Approved / Approved with conditions / Not approved / More evidence required

03-zero-trust.purpose: Map identity, access, data, visibility, and automation assumptions.
03-zero-trust.when_to_use: Use when trust boundaries, access paths, or continuous verification need review.
03-zero-trust.primary_decision: Green / Amber / Red / More evidence required

04-llm-risk.purpose: Track OWASP-aligned LLM and generative AI risks.
04-llm-risk.when_to_use: Use when an LLM, RAG system, agent, copilot, model provider, or AI tool is in scope.
04-llm-risk.primary_decision: Accept / Mitigate / Transfer / Reject / More evidence required

05-secure-by-design.purpose: Review secure defaults, transparency, vulnerability handling, and AI-specific design.
05-secure-by-design.when_to_use: Use before release, launch, publication, demo, pilot, or partner review.
05-secure-by-design.primary_decision: Ready / Ready with conditions / Not ready / More evidence required

06-software-supply-chain.purpose: Review dependencies, SBOM readiness, provenance, and release hygiene.
06-software-supply-chain.when_to_use: Use before publishing code, tools, templates, software, or AI-enabled workflows.
06-software-supply-chain.primary_decision: Green / Amber / Red / More evidence required

07-cyber-survivability.purpose: Review prevent, mitigate, and recover posture for high-impact cyber disruption.
07-cyber-survivability.when_to_use: Use for operational, sensitive, high-impact, or resilience-critical systems.
07-cyber-survivability.primary_decision: Green / Amber / Red / More evidence required

08-high-impact-systems.purpose: Organize public-safe readiness evidence for sensitive or operational workflows.
08-high-impact-systems.when_to_use: Use when reliability, access control, data integrity, rollback, recovery, and human approval gates matter.
08-high-impact-systems.primary_decision: Green / Amber / Red / More evidence required

09-incident-review.purpose: Document incidents, near misses, response, recovery, and lessons learned.
09-incident-review.when_to_use: Use after a security, privacy, availability, integrity, AI, automation, or supply-chain incident.
09-incident-review.primary_decision: Review complete / Follow-up required / More evidence required

10-examples.purpose: Provide synthetic, public-safe examples of the review method.
10-examples.when_to_use: Use for onboarding, demos, documentation, and agent training without exposing real sensitive data.
